text: player

There's a dark and strange underground forest in front of us, and the rugged path is covered with leaves that are wet with cold dew. As we walk, the sound of crumpling leaves and broken sticks echoes behind us.
Momo Hina
Mr. Rabbit, where are you? L-Let's go back if you can't find the White Rabbit...
I turn around quickly after hearing Momo Hina's anxious voice. After just a few steps, I see Momo Hina's small figure hidden in the shadow of a bush.
Don't be scared. I'll come and find you.
Taking Momo Hina's hand again, I look around and let out a deep sigh.
Mr. Rabbit, is this really Wonderland? It's... so scary here.
Upon hearing Momo Hina's doubts, I decide to write down on the feedback form at the exit that this is definitely not an attraction for parents to enjoy with their children!
Don't worry. Everything will be alright. Do you remember what the staff told us when we came in?
I remember. The lady at the entrance said we must protect our cards and make sure we never let the patrolling Knaves of Hearts catch us.
I listened carefully to everything!

I touch the two cards in my pocket: the King of Hearts representing my identity and the Six of Hearts representing Momo Hina's identity. She gave her card to me for safekeeping because she was afraid that she'd lose it while running.
Hmm? It sounds like the hoofbeats of a horse... Could it be the Knaves of Hearts?
Speak of the devil... I grab Momo Hina and hide in the woods nearby. Momo Hina can't run very fast because she's too little, so our best option is to hide in the bush.
Knave of Hearts A
This is strange. I'm sure I saw someone.
Knave of Hearts B
That Alice is too cunning. We must sacrifice her to the Red Queen after catching her and make sure she receives the harshest punishment!
Let's go take a look over there.
Momo Hina and I hold our breath and wait until the two Knaves of Hearts disappear in the distance before we dare to emerge from behind the bushes.
M-Mr. Rabbit, it's safe now. The Knaves of Hearts are chasing Alice in the story. We should be okay.
I can see that she's trying her best to be brave even though she's feeling really anxious, so I pat her head.
Momo Hina, you're just as brave as Alice.
Huh? Really?
The girl looks at me with bright eyes, feeling happy after being praised.
Baa!
Suddenly, we hear the sad cry of a sheep that sounds strangely familiar...
This is strange... Why is there a sheep in Wonderland? Mr. Rabbit, sh-should we go take a look?
This can't be a trap by the Knaves of Hearts, right?
Shaun, don't give up! Heave-ho!
After we hear the sheep's braying, we hear the voice of a girl we're much more familiar with.
We follow the sound all the way behind some tall trees and see a large clump of crystals blocking the only path ahead of us.
A sheep that is stuck in the clump of crystal is braying constantly. Beside it, a girl who has long light-gold hair is struggling to get it free.
Eliisa?
Eliisa
Mr. Wolf? Mr. Wolf, come and save Shaun!
The moment she sees us, Eliisa rushes up to me and communicates her intentions to me with her words and body language.

Two people wearing red clothes have been chasing Liisa Liisa and Shaun everywhere since we came in... We kept running and running... Suddenly, a slope appeared in front of us, and Shaun slipped down it. After that, Liisa Liisa noticed that Shaun was stuck here...
Liisa Liisa has tried everything, but... Huh? Can you hear that?!
That's the sound we've been hearing, Mr. Wolf. This sound has been chasing Liisa Liisa and Shaun everywhere!
It's the Knaves of Hearts!
The Kites... of Hearts?
It's the Knaves of Hearts. I bet you didn't listen carefully to the staff's explanation at the entrance.
Ehehe... you caught me, Mr. Wolf. It's because the forest seemed to be calling out to Liisa Liisa...
I bet your heart was already inside when you were still at the entrance.
Hehe! Mr. Wolf knows Liisa Liisa so well!
We don't have time to talk about that right now... Let's break the crystal!
Huh? Are we allowed to damage the props?
The staff didn't say that we can't damage the props when we entered... If we aren't allowed to, then we can only give up on Shaun.
No! Mr. Wolf, Liisa Liisa can't leave Shaun behind and run away!
W-We better destroy the props then!
We look everywhere and find a few scattered kerosene lamps nearby, and their sturdy handles are perfect for breaking the clump of crystal.
We get right to it. We pick up the kerosene lamps and start to attack the clump of crystal.
Finally, Momo Hina deals the last blow, shattering the crystal with a crack.
Let me listen carefully to see where that sound came from... Aha! I think it's this way!
The Knaves of Hearts are coming! Let's run!
I grab Momo Hina's hand, Momo Hina grabs Eliisa, and Eliisa grabs Shaun, who is limping... No matter how I think about it, there's no way we'll be able to run away!
Oh my gosh! They actually destroyed the Red Queen's favorite clump of crystal.
She's going to be furious! We have to catch the criminals and bring them to her.
After speaking, the two Knaves of Hearts look at us with bright piercing eyes.
We can let you go as long as you hand over the criminal who destroyed the crystal.
Tell us the card of the criminal.
It looks like we've finally triggered the story. According to my experience of escape rooms, the decision I make now will affect the ending. What should I do? Whose card should I tell them?
I need to step up in this situation. I'll tell them mine!
Follow the rules of the game and report Momo Hina's one.
Don't say anything! Silence is the best defense!
King of Hearts.
But Mr. Rabbit, you're not the one...
Mmm! Are the hunters going to capture Mr. Wolf? No! Liisa Liisa wants to be punished alongside Mr. Wolf!
Same here!

Holding each other's hand, Eliisa and Momo Hina stand in front of me, and I can see their shoulders trembling slightly. It's obvious that they are scared, but they haven't cowered back in fear, which makes my heart feel warm and fuzzy.
That's brave and responsible of you... You almost moved me.
In that case, let's catch them all and let the Red Queen judge them.
Didn't you say you would only catch one of us?
That was then, and this is now. Follow us now.
The two Knaves of Hearts make the three of us and Shaun walk between them as we walk deeper into the forest.
On the way, Momo Hina holds my hand and whispers to me to comfort me, while Eliisa waves her fist in the air next to me.
If they really try to bully Mr. Wolf, Liisa Liisa will also do her best!

Eliisa covers her mouth anxiously and glances at the Knaves of Hearts in front of her. She looks at me unwaveringly to tell me that I have nothing to worry about because she is here. As for how I understood her message, it could be due to our tacit understanding or simply because her pure eyes are so easy to read.

As the road becomes wider, many clumps of crystals surrounded by fireflies appear on both sides of the road. The rock above us is inscribed with murals of Alice in Wonderland. It's as if we are in a fairy tale.
When we arrive in a courtyard filled with flowers, the two Knaves of Hearts suddenly remove their hats and salute us.
Congratulations, brave Alices, you've passed the White Queen's test.
You can claim your reward now.
The White Queen? Test? ...Does that mean we cleared the escape room?

The Knaves of Hearts respond by gesturing for us to help ourselves. I glance at the two excited girls who are running gleefully into the courtyard. I guess it's okay. This level of difficulty is just right for an attraction designed for parents and their children.
Mmm! Is that a dancing rabbit?
There you are! Let's go--
After hearing Eliisa's reminder, we see a rabbit with a pocket watch hanging around its neck. The three of us and Shaun chase it up the winding steps.
The steps take us to a large and lush garden with a new and dreamlike float parked in front of us.
The caterpillar helps us change into gorgeous clothes. After that, the White Queen emerges slowly from the depths of the garden--
Ciri?!
White Queen (Ciri)
Shush--
Ciri motions for us to be quiet, then she clears her throat.
You're finally here. Follow me, the Hatter can't wait to meet you.

She leans slightly sideways, revealing Ryan dressed as the Hatter behind her. Ryan takes off his hat and bows to us. After that, several rabbits with pocket watches on them jump out of the hat and scamper around us.
Ryan
Alices, welcome to Wonderland.
The float parade is about to start.
We look where he is pointing and see a gorgeous carriage decorated with flowers parked in the middle of the garden.
Mr. Rabbit, you really are the wisest person ever! You really did take me to Wonderland and the float!
Mmm! Liisa Liisa has cleared the stage and won! Mr. Wolf has cleared the stage! It's a great victory for Mr. Wolf!
I look into the innocent eyes of the girls and decide to give this fairy tale about Wonderland a happy ending. I step forward and reach out to Momo Hina and Eliisa.
My brave Alice and Little Red Riding Hood, will you join me for this grand float parade?
Since this is a game, it's better to follow the rules of the game.
The card is... the Six of Hearts.
Huh... that's my card.
Whoa! Mr. Wolf, are you thinking of letting the Black Queen catch Momo Hina?
I-It's the Red Queen...
It doesn't matter! They will be catching you.
I-It's okay. Mom has always told me that I shouldn't lie even if I do something bad, or else I would be a bad girl.
Knaves of Hearts, I broke the crystal!
No! Momo Hina only accidentally damaged the crystal to save Shaun!
Eliisa holds Momo Hina's hand and stands firmly by her side.
You're all brave Alices. Follow me then.
Knave of Hearts A takes them to another path in the forest. I'm a little worried... so maybe I should follow them and see what happens.
Huh?
Please turn back. You've been disqualified from participating in the next part.
Is that also a rule of the game...? Okay then.
Knave of Hearts B guides me back to the entrance of the attraction.
Hmm? Is there a float parade here?

The destination of the float seems to be the entrance of the attraction where I'm currently standing. After it drives closer, I see that Momo Hina and Eliisa dressed as Alice are on the float. After it stops, they jump off and run up to me excitedly.
Hehe... the Hatter said that Mr. Rabbit gave up the chance to be Alice to me and Liisa Liisa...
I thought I would never be able to see you again after receiving the Red Queen's punishment.
Haha... is that so?
I knew we mistook Mr. Wolf's good intentions!
We mistook his... good intentions? What do you mean? What... did we mistake about Mr. Rabbit's intentions?
They think they have mistaken my intentions, but my guilt tells me I really have made a mistake.
It doesn't matter now. Looking at their innocent expressions... I think I shouldn't say anything so that I won't ruin their good impression of me.
I look at the advertisement at the entrance that reads "explore endless possibilities and create your own ending." I think I should explore another ending next time if I get the chance.
Wh-What tactic is this?
We'll catch you all if you don't answer us.
Fine then. My card is the Two of Clubs.
Since they are forcing us to say something, I decide to say any card. It's not like they said we aren't allowed to lie.
You're lying. None of you have the Two of Clubs.
Those who lie need to be punished more severely!
Yes, you'll need to be punished more severely. Follow us.
Mr. Wolf!
Mr. Rabbit!
Don't worry, I'll be fine.
After comforting Momo Hina and Eliisa, I follow the Knaves of Hearts to the end of the forest.
In the middle of something that looks like an underground garden, I see a person dressed in red sitting on a red chair with their back to me...
Are you the Red Queen?
Hehehe... why haven't you paid me your respects if you've identified me?
Wait, this way of talking... you're Kaguyahime?
Kaguyahime walks towards me in the darkness, and the two cards between her fingers barely cover the lower half of her face.
Why are you here?
Kaguyahime
This is Wonderland? Why can't I be here?
Kaguyahime pulls me to the chair, then she pushes me onto the red chair with her gentle fingers and takes the card in my hand.
The King of Hearts... Hehehe.
Kaguyahime laughs as she reveals her own card, the Queen of Hearts.
Well, my dear King of Hearts, welcome to the castle of the Queen of Hearts! It's now time for your punishment.
Wait, Kaguyahime! Something isn't right about this story. This is supposed to be Wonderland, not a trap!
I have no words to express the torment I suffered that day. My only advice for everyone is that you must never be one of those bad children who tell lies...

After hearing about this large attraction that is said to be based on the story of Alice in Wonderland, Momo Hina and I came here today to experience it, but we haven't seen anything remotely related to Wonderland, let alone the White Rabbit with the pocket watch.
I think I hear something...
It looks like it isn't a trap after all.
Don't be scared, Mr. Rabbit. I'll do my best to protect you. Th-The Red Queen doesn't scare me! I'm telling the truth...
L-Liisa Liisa, you're too loud. The Knaves of Hearts will hear you.
Momo Hina looks at me. No, her gaze is just too innocent and harmless! My guilty conscience makes me look down quickly. This is just a game, so it should be okay, right?
